summary_en: MBK reports cumulative acquisition of 3,514,700 shares for 785.9 million yen as of August 31, 2026, representing 10.7% of issued shares excluding treasury stock, under a buyback program authorized in December 2025 with a 4.1 million share or 820 million yen ceiling through December 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Progress of Share Buyback Program
translation_en_brief: MBK Co., Ltd. announced the progress of its share buyback program authorized by the Board of Directors on December 12, 2025, and updated on May 18, 2026. As of August 31, 2026, the company has cumulatively acquired 3,514,700 shares for a total of 785,928,000 yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. This represents 10.7% of issued shares excluding treasury stock. The buyback program runs from January 30, 2026 through December 11, 2026, with a maximum authorization of 4,100,000 shares or 820,000,000 yen. In August 2026 alone, the company made no purchases. The calculation of the percentage (10.7%) is derived by dividing the 3,514,700 cumulative shares acquired by the implied outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock) of approximately 32,806,190 minus 2,058,325 existing treasury shares, equaling 30,747,865 shares.
